rv.q: While Precarious has not yet fully solved its structural challenges, it demonstrates considerable promise and offers three compelling performances worth seeing.
At points, it is truly hard-hitting and, at the same time, emotionally complex in a beautifully poetic way…some very thought-provoking and poignant moments.
There is much to admire about Precarious (which Mosaic has been workshopping with the playwright since 2024), but the production suffers from a few cracks in the foundation.
Schraf ensures we're engaged, at least, and considering the woman's humanity fully, regardless of how one might respond to, or question, her fanatical devotion to cleaning up the environment.

It was director Jaki Bradley's staging of this moment, consistent with the rest of the production, with its focused, clear guidance of this comedic A-team cast (and the taught written script) that summoned our almost projectile laughter.
